'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Michael Klimenko DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Klimenko]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
